note: Over the review events a client holds: a valid review E links to T when E.payload.replaces equals T.id (T.id != E.id), both are valid reviews (review-parse.json) of the same workspace and cardId, and their instants fall in the same whole second. Links join reviews into families (connected components); in each family only the greatest id (plain string comparison) counts, every other member is replaced and counts nowhere. live: the ids that count, in (instant, id) order; replaced: the replaced ids, sorted.

cases.name: a misclick replaced by the intended grade
cases.note: Again, then Good replacing it with the same ts: only Good counts; another card is unaffected

cases.name: a replacement with the same grade
cases.note: harmless: the target is replaced by an equal review

cases.name: two devices replace the same review
cases.note: one family of three; the greatest id survives

cases.name: a chain of replacements
cases.note: a replacement of a replacement: the last survives, the first stays replaced

cases.name: a fork of a chain
cases.note: one device replaced its replacement, another replaced the original: the greatest id of the whole family survives, never two

cases.name: a replacement held before its target
cases.note: the target has not arrived: the reference dangles and the replacement counts as an ordinary review

cases.name: the target arrives after its replacement
cases.note: the rule reads the set, not the arrival order: the late target is replaced

cases.name: a dangling reference
cases.note: a target that never arrives (lost, or another user's id) voids nothing

cases.name: a reference to another card is ignored
cases.note: a link needs the same cardId

cases.name: a reference to another workspace is ignored
cases.note: a link needs the same workspace

cases.name: a reference to another second is ignored
cases.note: a link needs the same whole second: the replacement copies the target's ts

cases.name: a millisecond copy is the same second
cases.note: the web's outbox copy keeps milliseconds and an offset; the server copy is whole UTC seconds: floor(instant / 1000 ms) is compared

cases.name: two reviews naming each other
cases.note: a cycle is one family with one survivor

cases.name: a reference to itself is ignored
cases.note: T.id must differ from E.id

cases.name: a target that is not a review is ignored
cases.note: grade 0 does not parse: the replacement counts alone

cases.name: a replacement whose ts does not parse is not a review
cases.note: it is never valid, so it links nothing: the target counts

cases.name: a non-string replaces is dropped
cases.note: the review stays an ordinary review

cases.name: an empty replaces is dropped
cases.note: an empty string names nothing

cases.name: one card corrected in two sessions
cases.note: families are per target: a correction on day 1 and a later ordinary review on day 2 both count

cases.name: a replacement of a replaced review
cases.note: naming a member that is no longer the survivor still joins the family: the greatest id survives

cases.name: a replacement whose id sorts below its target loses
cases.note: the greatest id survives, whichever names which: a writer whose clock is behind must still give the replacement an id above the one it names (ulidTime(target) + 1 at least), else the misclick keeps counting

generated.note: random families (seeded): the same rule as the hand-written cases; live and replaced from an independent oracle
